info.title: Oriva Platform API
info.description: Public API for 3rd party Oriva developers. Authenticate with your API key as a Bearer token.

token.description: Full token value — displayed ONCE. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

prefix.description: First 20 characters of the token, safe to display later.

url.description: Hosted Checkout URL. Redirect the buyer here.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the Checkout Session expires.

apiToken.description: A personal/API token for the external tool (headless connect).

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

listingId.description: The marketplace listing (entry) id to buy.

expectedAmountCents.description: The exact current total you agreed to pay, in cents (1200 = 12.00). If the listing price differs, the purchase is refused before any charge.

variantIndex.description: Which of the listing's price variants to buy (0-based). Omit for the default.

status.description: Status of the earlier attempt with this Idempotency-Key.

error.description: The card decline's own message, or "The card was not charged."

reason.description: Why it was refused or failed, when it was.

url.description: An https address on cdn.oriva.io (images must be uploaded to Oriva first).

alt.description: What the image shows, for screen readers and search. A published page refuses a shown image without one, unless `decorative`.

decorative.description: True for a purely decorative image, which needs no `alt`.

text.description: Plain text; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

note.description: A short second value: a price, a time, or the other column of a comparison.

points.description: Bullet points under the item, one line each (What you get).

href.description: A link to another Oriva offer only: `/item/<id>`, `/checkout/<id>`, or the same on https://oriva.io.

imageSize.description: "wide": the image spans the item; otherwise it sits beside the text.

areas.description: 3 to 12 named areas, each up to 40 characters.

weakest.description: Index into `areas` of the weakest one.

survey.description: An animated self-assessment that sorts the areas by score (What you get).

fan.description: 3 to 9 card names fanned out at the top of the item (What you get).

contents.description: Headings inside, shown as a short contents list.

preview.description: A "Preview" button that opens an excerpt (What you get).

x.description: Callout position across, in percent (annotated screenshot).

y.description: Callout position down, in percent (annotated screenshot).

id.description: Unique short name: starts with a letter, lowercase letters and digits only, up to 12.

start.description: Where the slider starts, inside the range.

sliders.description: Up to 3 sliders, each a percentage from 0 to 100.

incomeLabel.description: Label of the income box; leave out for no income box.

note.description: One line under the buy button.

daysPerYear.description: Working days in a year, for `{<id>_days}`.

sentence.description: May name `{<id>}` and `{<id>_days}` for any slider id.

withIncome.description: Used once the visitor enters an income; may also name `{<id>_money}`. Needs `incomeLabel`.

SalesCalculator.description: The cost calculator section, worked out in the visitor's browser and never stored.

body.description: Plain text, never HTML; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

videoUrl.description: An https video on cdn.oriva.io, YouTube or Vimeo.

labels.description: Column headings, for the comparison table.

oneRow.description: Proof quote cards in one sideways-scrolling row.

buyNote.description: One short line under the hero's buy button.

calendar.description: "Add to calendar" under the next live session (hero).

videoCard.description: A video card that opens the video in a window.

since.description: Count paid orders from this moment (ISO 8601); all of them when absent.

leftNote.description: Words after the number of places left.

giveaway.description: A giveaway for the first buyers (What you get); the page shows how many are left.

packageValue.description: What everything in the offer costs bought separately (hero); each buy button then shows the saving.

areas.description: 3 to 12 named areas, each up to 40 characters.

weakest.description: Index into `areas` of the weakest one.

wheel.description: A wheel that spins and stops on the weakest area (problem).

SalesSectionContent.description: The same fields serve every section type; each type draws the ones that suit it. In outline: the hero uses eyebrow, heading, body, image or videoUrl, buyNote, calendar, packageValue; problem uses heading, body, quote, wheel; how_it_works, what_you_get, proof, questions and most library components use heading plus items (what_you_get items may carry points, fan, preview, survey, image; proof uses quote cards and oneRow); comparison_table uses labels and items with note as the other column; annotated_screenshot uses image plus items with x and y; video uses videoUrl; calculator uses calculator; related_offers uses items with href.

id.description: Your own id for the section, unique on the page: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 40.

type.description: The kind of section. The page's own sections (hero, buy_box, problem, general_solution, specific_solution, how_it_works, what_you_get, proof, questions, guarantee, creator) may each appear once; the library components (module_showcase, preview_gallery, demonstration, look_inside, annotated_screenshot, icon_row, multicolumn, image_with_text, rich_text, comparison_table, video, testimonials, collapsible_questions, related_offers, order_box, whole_path, what_this_is_not, card_grid, creator_quote, final_cta, calculator) as often as wanted. A page sells only through a shown checkout hero (design "a"), buy_box, order_box or final_cta.

design.description: The page's own sections have two designs (default a); for hero, a has the checkout and b an image or video. Library components have one.

hidden.description: Keep the section but do not show it.

accent.description: One of the offered accent colours. Defaults to #4B58D6.

SalesTheme.description: How the sales page looks. Sent alone on updateListing, it restyles the page the listing already has.

hint.description: What to change, when the content check refused it.

problems.description: Every reason the sales page cannot go live yet, when that is the refusal.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

problems.description: Each problem found, when there are several (the sales page, the add-on or the sales chat).

hint.description: What to change, when the content check refused it.

description.description: What is being sold, up to 20,000 characters. Runs through the content check.

price.description: Price in currency units (12 = 12.00), 0 to 10000. A paid listing is at least 1.

currency.description: Only USD is supported. Defaults to USD.

itemType.description: Kind of item. Defaults to digital.

topics.description: Up to 4 of the marketplace's topics the listing is filed under, so buyers find it under that topic. Publishing needs at least one; a draft may have none. A subtopic id (topic-health-nutrition) is best sent with its parent (topic-parent-health).

profileId.description: One of the owner's named profiles to list under. Defaults to their default profile.

publish.description: Publish now (default true). Send false to save a draft; publishing a paid listing needs a paid Oriva plan.

salesSections.description: The offer's sales page, top to bottom, up to 40 sections: the same page the offer form builds. Checked by the offer form's rules (400 with `problems`). A published listing's page must also be able to go live: a way to buy, no [placeholder] text, and every shown image described (422 with `problems`).

seoTitle.description: How the offer is titled in search results, link previews and the browser tab, up to 60 characters. Null or empty uses the automatic title.

seoDescription.description: The line under the title in search results and link previews, up to 160 characters. Null or empty uses the automatic text.

title.description: Up to 200 characters; cannot be empty.

description.description: Up to 20,000 characters. Runs through the content check.

price.description: Price in currency units, 0 to 10000; a paid listing is at least 1. Refused (409) for a listing with price options, which are changed in the offer form.

topics.description: Replaces the listing's topics: up to 4 of the marketplace's own. A published listing needs at least one.

publish.description: True publishes the listing, false takes it back to a draft. Leave out to keep it as it is.

salesSections.description: Replaces the whole sales page, top to bottom (the same shape as on createListing). Null removes the page. Checked as on createListing: 400 with `problems` when it fails, 422 with `problems` when the listing is or goes live and the page cannot.

description.description: One line under the tick box at checkout.

shipTo.description: Two-letter country codes (US, GB); at least one for a physical add-on.

addOn.description: An extra the buyer can tick at checkout. Null removes it. 400 with `problems` when it fails the check.

notes.description: What the sales assistant may tell visitors beyond the page.

contactUrl.description: Where a visitor reaches the seller when the assistant cannot answer: an https:// link or a mailto: address.

salesChat.description: The sales page's chat assistant. Null removes its settings. 400 with `problems` when it fails the check.

seoTitle.description: How the offer is titled in search results, link previews and the browser tab, up to 60 characters. Null or empty uses the automatic title.

seoDescription.description: The line under the title in search results and link previews, up to 160 characters. Null or empty uses the automatic text.

UpdateListingBody.description: Send only what changes; at least one field.

salesPage.description: Whether the listing now has a sales page.

post.description:
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session and returns a one-time hosted payment URL.

**Funds-flow modes**

| Mode | When | Who is charged | Oriva fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Direct Charge** | `merchant_connect_account_id` present | Buyer charged via merchant Connect account | 10% `application_fee_amount` deducted at charge time. `funds_flow=direct_charge` written to session metadata. |
| **Separate Transfers** | `merchant_connect_account_id` absent | Buyer charged on Oriva platform account | REA cron distributes author share post-settlement. `funds_flow=separate_transfers` written to session metadata. |

The `funds_flow` field in the Stripe metadata is set automatically by the server based on the presence of `merchant_connect_account_id` — callers do not set it.

Requires an active `oriva_pk_` API key whose owner has a registered REA agent record.

amount_cents.description: Charge amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents for USD). Range 1–99,999,999.

description.description: Product description shown on the Stripe Checkout page.

merchant_connect_account_id.description: Stripe Connect account ID (format: acct_…). When present the session runs as a Direct Charge: Stripe charges the buyer via the merchant account; Oriva collects a 10% application fee. When absent the session falls back to Separate Transfers: Oriva charges on the platform account and distributes via the REA payout cron.

oriva_manifest_id.description: REA manifest UUID for skill royalty attribution.

oriva_invocation_id.description: Unique invocation UUID for analytics and deduplication.

success_url.description: URL the buyer is redirected to after a successful payment. Must use https://.

cancel_url.description: URL the buyer is redirected to if they abandon the checkout. Must use https://.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs forwarded to the Stripe Checkout Session metadata.

200.description: Checkout Session created. Redirect the buyer to `data.url`.

post.summary: Buy a marketplace listing with the owner's money, within their limits
post.description:
Spends the API key owner's REAL money: charges the card they saved, only after they switched agent buying on and only within the per-purchase and per-day limits they set at https://oriva.io/settings/agent-buying. Use only when the owner has asked you to buy this listing; do not use to check a price (read the listing first) or to browse.

- `expectedAmountCents` must be the exact current total; a different price is refused.
- Always send an `Idempotency-Key` and reuse it when retrying the same purchase; a repeat returns the first attempt (200, `repeat: true`) instead of buying twice.
- 201 bought. 202 not finished yet: it still counts against the limits, so do NOT buy again; check `listAgentPurchases` later.
- 403 `refused: true` is final (switched off, over a limit, price changed, own listing...): do not retry; tell the owner the reason.
- 402 the card was not charged.

Authorised only by a personal access token (`Bearer oriva_pk_...`), never a browser session. Served by https://oriva.io, not api.oriva.io.

schema.description: Your id for this purchase attempt, up to 200 characters. Resending the same key returns the first attempt instead of buying again. Always send one, and reuse it when retrying the same purchase. If omitted, the SDK, CLI and MCP server generate one and report it.

parameters.description: Your id for this purchase attempt, up to 200 characters. Resending the same key returns the first attempt instead of buying again. Always send one, and reuse it when retrying the same purchase. If omitted, the SDK, CLI and MCP server generate one and report it.

401.description: Missing or invalid personal access token.

403.description: Refused, and final: agent buying switched off, over a limit, price changed, own listing, or the account has no email. Do not retry.

post.summary: List an item for sale in the marketplace in the owner's name
post.description:
Creates a marketplace listing as the API key owner, under the same content check as one made in the browser. Works only once the owner has switched agent listing on at https://oriva.io/settings/agent-buying (off by default); at most 20 agent listings an hour. Use when the owner asks you to sell something. Do not use to buy (use `buyListing`) or to change an existing listing (use `updateListing`). Choose `topics` from the marketplace's own list (see the field); publishing needs at least one.

Send `salesSections` (and optionally `salesTheme`) to give the offer its sales page, the same page the offer form builds; `seoTitle` and `seoDescription` set how it reads in search results.

- 400: a field is out of range (for `topics`, the error lists the topics to choose from), or the sales page failed the check; `problems` lists every fault, fix them all before retrying.
- 422: the content check refused it (`hint` says what to change); the sales page cannot go live yet (`problems`: no way to buy, [placeholder] text, an image without a description; or save a draft); or a free listing has nothing for a visitor to get, since this route sets no delivery.
- 403: listing switched off, a paid listing needs a paid plan (retry with `publish: false` to save a draft), or the profile is not the owner's. Do not retry unchanged.
- 429: over 20 listings an hour; wait before retrying.

Served by https://oriva.io, not api.oriva.io.

201.description: Listed (or saved as a draft when publish was false).

400.description: Invalid input — the message names the field; for a sales page, `problems` lists every fault.

401.description: Missing or invalid personal access token.

403.description: Agent listing switched off, this token may not list, paid listing on a free plan, no named profile, or a profile that is not the owner's.

422.description: Refused by the content check (change what `hint` says), a sales page that cannot go live yet (`problems`), or a free listing with nothing to get.

429.description: More than 20 agent listings in the last hour. Try again later.

patch.summary: Change a listing in the owner's name: its text, price, sales page, or whether it is live
patch.description:
Changes one of the API key owner's own listings, as an edit in the offer form would, under the same content check. Send only the fields that change. Needs agent listing switched on at https://oriva.io/settings/agent-buying; creating and changing listings share 60 actions an hour. Use when the owner asks you to revise a listing or its sales page, publish a draft, or take a listing down. Do not use to create one (use `createListing`).

The rules for a live listing apply to the RESULT: publishing needs a topic and, for a paid listing, a paid Oriva plan; its sales page must have a way to buy, no [placeholder] text, and every shown image described; and it must be something a visitor can get (paid, or free with a delivery the seller set). A sales page you write is marked as written by an agent, and the offer form tells the seller so.

- 400: a field is wrong, nothing was sent, or the sales page, add-on or sales chat failed its check; `problems` lists every fault.
- 404: no listing of the owner's has that id (the same answer for someone else's).
- 409: the listing has price options; change its prices in the offer form.
- 422: the content check refused it (`hint`), the sales page cannot go live (`problems`; or keep it a draft with `publish: false`), or a free listing has nothing to get.
- 403: listing switched off, this token may not list, or a paid listing on a free plan. Do not retry unchanged.
- 429: over 60 listing actions an hour; wait before retrying.

Served by https://oriva.io, not api.oriva.io.
